CustomField.formula: if( year(Date__c)!=year(today()), IF( OR( Month_Report__c != MONTH(TODAY()), AND( Month_Report__c = MONTH(TODAY()), day(Date__c)<=day(today()) ) ), Amount_Report__c, 0 ), IF( OR( Month_Report__c != MONTH(TODAY()), AND( Month_Report__c = MONTH(TODAY()), day(Date__c)<=day(today()) ) ), Amount_Report__c, (Amount_Report__c / Day_number_in_a_month__c) * Number_of_Day_Today__c) )
CustomField.label: Amount Report MTD
